-- โหลดบริการและตัวแปรหลัก
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- สร้าง ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AdvancedAimbotGui_Rainbow"
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui

-- ตัวแปรตั้งค่าระบบ
getgenv().AimbotEnabled = false
getgenv().AimbotMode = "Closest" -- "Closest" หรือ "FOV"
getgenv().FOVShow = false
getgenv().FOVRadius = 120 -- ขนาดรัศมีเริ่มต้น

-- สร้างวงกลม FOV (Drawing API)
local FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVCircle.Visible = false
FOVCircle.Radius = getgenv().FOVRadius
FOVCircle.Thickness = 2
FOVCircle.Transparency = 0.8
FOVCircle.Filled = false

-- ฟังก์ชันคำนวณสีรุ้งตามเวลา (Rainbow Color)
local function GetRainbowColor()
    local tickTime = tick() * 5
    local r = math.sin(tickTime) * 127 + 128
    local g = math.sin(tickTime + 2) * 127 + 128
    local b = math.sin(tickTime + 4) * 127 + 128
    return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
end

-- อัปเดตตำแหน่งและสีวงกลมทุกเฟรม
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    FOVCircle.Position = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    FOVCircle.Radius = getgenv().FOVRadius
    if getgenv().FOVShow then
        FOVCircle.Visible = true
        FOVCircle.Color = GetRainbowColor()
    else
        FOVCircle.Visible = false
    end
end)

FOVLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans

        ToggleBtn.Text = "Aimbot: ON"
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 50)
    else

        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
    end
end)

    if getgenv().AimbotMode == "Closest" then
        getgenv().AimbotMode = "FOV"
        ModeBtn.Text = "Mode: FOV Target"
    else
        getgenv().AimbotMode = "Closest"
        ModeBtn.Text = "Mode: Closest"
    end
end)

-- ควบคุมปุ่มเปิด/ปิดวงกลม FOV
FOVBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    getgenv().FOVShow = not getgenv().FOVShow
    if getgenv().FOVShow then
        FOVBtn.Text = "FOV Circle: ON"
        FOVBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 200)
    else
        FOVBtn.Text = "FOV Circle: OFF"
        FOVBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    end
end)

-- ปรับเพิ่มขนาดวงกลม
PlusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    getgenv().FOVRadius = math.min(getgenv().FOVRadius + 20, 400)
    FOVLabel.Text = "FOV Size: " .. tostring(getgenv().FOVRadius)
end)

-- ปรับลดขนาดวงกลม
MinusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    getgenv().FOVRadius = math.max(getgenv().FOVRadius - 20, 20)
    FOVLabel.Text = "FOV Size: " .. tostring(getgenv().FOVRadius)
end)

-- ฟังก์ชันค้นหาเป้าหมาย
local function GetTarget()
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = math.huge
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local screenPos = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
                    local dist = (screenPos - screenCenter).Magnitude

                    if getgenv().AimbotMode == "Closest" then
                        if dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    elseif getgenv().AimbotMode == "FOV" then
                        if dist <= getgenv().FOVRadius and dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

-- ลูปการทำงานล็อกเป้า
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if getgenv().AimbotEnabled then
        local targetPart = GetTarget()
        if targetPart then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
        end
    end
end)

-- // Delta Executor - Drone com Comando Estilo DJI RC (v3 com Térmico e Bombas)
-- Só toque (telemóvel): joystick esquerdo = altura/girar | joystick direito = mover

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- Se executares o script outra vez, limpa a versão anterior
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if env.__DroneCleanup then pcall(env.__DroneCleanup) end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

if Workspace:FindFirstChild("RealisticDroneModel") then Workspace.RealisticDroneModel:Destroy() end
if player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("DJIRCControlGui") then player.PlayerGui.DJIRCControlGui:Destroy() end

-- Configuração
local SPEED, VSPEED, YAW_SPEED = 40, 25, 2.2
local DEFAULT_FOV = 70

-- Estado
local conns = {}
local flying, mode = false, "manual" -- manual | takeoff | rth | follow | land
local battery = 100
local yaw = 0
local curVel = Vector3.zero
local curTiltF, curTiltS = 0, 0
local rotorSpeed, rotorAngle = 0, 0
local cameraAttached, recording, recTime = false, false, 0
local fov = DEFAULT_FOV
local stickL, stickR = Vector2.zero, Vector2.zero
local rotors = {}

-- Efeitos extra
local thermalOn = false
local colorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")

local function getHumanoid()
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Modelo do drone
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local droneModel = Instance.new("Model")
droneModel.Name = "RealisticDroneModel"
droneModel.Parent = Workspace

local dronePart = Instance.new("Part")
dronePart.Name = "DroneCore"
dronePart.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.6, 2.5)
dronePart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
dronePart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 60, 65)
dronePart.CanCollide = false
dronePart.Parent = droneModel
droneModel.PrimaryPart = dronePart

-- Raycast para descobrir o chão
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {droneModel, character}

local function groundY(pos)
    local r = Workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), rayParams)
    return r and r.Position.Y or nil
end

-- Posição inicial: no chão, à frente do jogador
local look = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
local startPos = rootPart.Position + look * 4
local startGround = groundY(startPos + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
dronePart.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPos.X, (startGround or (rootPart.Position.Y - 2.5)) + 0.9, startPos.Z)
    * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)

local function weldTo(p0, p1)
    local w = Instance.new("Weld")
    w.Part0 = p0
    w.Part1 = p1
    w.C0 = p0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame)
    w.Parent = p0
    return w
end

local function addPart(size, offset, color, material, shape)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Size = size
    p.CFrame = dronePart.CFrame * offset
    p.Color = color
    p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    if shape then p.Shape = shape end
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.Massless = true
    p.Parent = droneModel
    return p, weldTo(dronePart, p)
end

-- Câmara gimbal e sensores
addPart(Vector3.new(0.6, 0.5, 0.6), CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.2), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Enum.Material.Metal)
addPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.3), CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.45), Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255), Enum.Material.Glass)
addPart(Vector3.new(1.2, 0.3, 0.4), CFrame.new(0, 0.1, -1.25), Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35))

-- Luz do drone
local lightColors = {
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
    Color3.fromRGB(180, 80, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
}
local lightIdx = 1
local lightOn = true
local lightPart = addPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.1, 0.4), CFrame.new(0, 0.35, 1.3), lightColors[1], Enum.Material.Neon)
local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
light.Color = lightColors[1]
light.Range = 15
light.Brightness = 4
light.Parent = lightPart

-- Braços, motores e hélices
for _, sx in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
    for _, sz in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
        local corner = Vector3.new(sx * 1.7, 0, sz * 1.7)
        addPart(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.15, corner.Magnitude), CFrame.lookAt(corner / 2, corner),
            Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 80))
        addPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.6, 0.6),
            CFrame.new(corner + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
            Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30), Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
        local blade, bw = addPart(Vector3.new(2.2, 0.05, 0.25),
            CFrame.new(corner + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0),
            Color3.fromRGB(240, 130, 0), Enum.Material.Neon)
        table.insert(rotors, {weld = bw, base = bw.C0, dir = (sx * sz > 0) and 1 or -1})
    end
end

local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
bv.Parent = dronePart

local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
bg.CFrame = dronePart.CFrame
bg.Parent = dronePart

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Interface (Comando com mais espaço para os novos botões)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function make(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    o.Parent = parent
    return o
end

local function roundify(o, r)
    make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)}, o)
end

local screenGui = make("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "DJIRCControlGui",
    ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

-- Corpo do comando (ligeiramente mais alto para caber tudo)
local rcFrame = make("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 244),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 55),

roundify(rcFrame, 14)

local topBar = make("Frame", {

roundify(topBar, 14)

local ledStatus = make("TextLabel", {

local btnClose = make("TextButton", {

    Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 2),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 30, 30),
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    Text = "X",
    TextSize = 10,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
}, topBar)
roundify(btnClose, 4)

-- Ecrã do comando (telemetria)
local screenDisplay = make("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 66),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 34),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, rcFrame)
roundify(screenDisplay, 8)

local screenLabel = make("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "🏔️ DRONE 4K\n[ Pronto para descolar ]",
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255),
    TextSize = 12,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
}, screenDisplay)

-- Botões Grid
local btnContainer = make("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 132),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 106),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, rcFrame)
make("UIGridLayout", {
    CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 28),
    CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 4),
    SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,

local btns, btnColors = {}, {}
local GRAY = Color3.fromRGB(80, 85, 95)

local function createRcBtn(name, text, off, on, order)
    local b = make("TextButton", {
        BackgroundColor3 = off,

        if delta.Magnitude > maxR then delta = delta.Unit * maxR end
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, delta.X, 0.5, delta.Y)
        callback(Vector2.new(delta.X / maxR, -delta.Y / maxR))
    end
    local function reset()
        active = nil
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        callback(Vector2.zero)
    end

    base.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

table.insert(conns, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not dronePart.Parent then cleanup() return end

    local pos = dronePart.Position
    local gy = groundY(pos)
    local minY = gy and (gy + 0.9) or -math.huge
    local yawIn, vertIn, strafeIn, fwdIn = getInput()
    local inputMag = math.abs(yawIn) + math.abs(vertIn) + math.abs(strafeIn) + math.abs(fwdIn)

    local vel = Vector3.zero
    local tiltF, tiltS = 0, 0

    if flying then
        battery = math.max(0, battery - dt * (0.5 + curVel.Magnitude / 80))
        if battery <= 0 and mode ~= "land" then
            setMode("land")
            toast("🔋 Bateria vazia, a aterrar")
        end
        if inputMag > 0.2 and battery > 0 and (mode == "rth" or mode == "follow" or mode == "land") then
            setMode("manual")
        end

        if mode == "takeoff" then
            vel = Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
            if pos.Y - (gy or (pos.Y - 3)) >= 3 then setMode("manual") end
        elseif mode == "manual" then
            yaw = yaw - yawIn * dt * YAW_SPEED
            local horiz = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(
                Vector3.new(strafeIn * SPEED, 0, -fwdIn * SPEED))
            vel = horiz + Vector3.new(0, vertIn * VSPEED, 0)
            tiltF, tiltS = fwdIn, strafeIn
        elseif mode == "rth" then
            local d = homePos() - pos
            local flat = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude > 3 then
                vel = flat.Unit * math.min(SPEED, flat.Magnitude * 3)
                    + Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(d.Y * 2, -VSPEED, VSPEED), 0)
                faceDir(flat, dt)
                tiltF = 0.6
            else
                setMode("land")
            end
        elseif mode == "follow" then
            local d = followPos() - pos
            vel = d * 3
            if vel.Magnitude > SPEED * 1.1 then vel = vel.Unit * SPEED * 1.1 end
            local toPlayer = rootPart.Position - pos
            faceDir(Vector3.new(toPlayer.X, 0, toPlayer.Z), dt)
        elseif mode == "land" then
            vel = Vector3.new(0, -8, 0)
            if gy and pos.Y <= minY + 0.15 then
                flying = false
                setMode("manual")
                refreshFlyBtn()
                toast("🛬 Aterrou")
            end
        end

        if pos.Y <= minY and vel.Y < 0 then
            vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
        end
    else
        battery = math.min(100, battery + dt * 3)
    end

    curVel = curVel:Lerp(vel, math.min(1, dt * 5))
    curTiltF = curTiltF + (tiltF - curTiltF) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
    curTiltS = curTiltS + (tiltS - curTiltS) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
    bv.Velocity = curVel
    bg.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-curTiltF * 0.3, 0, -curTiltS * 0.3)

    local targetRotor = flying and (45 + curVel.Magnitude * 0.5) or 0
    rotorSpeed = rotorSpeed + (targetRotor - rotorSpeed) * math.min(1, dt * 3)
    rotorAngle = rotorAngle + rotorSpeed * dt
    for _, r in ipairs(rotors) do
        r.weld.C0 = r.base * CFrame.Angles(0, rotorAngle * r.dir, 0)
    end

    if cameraAttached then
        local gp = dronePart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -0.2, -1.7))
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(gp) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
        camera.FieldOfView = fov
    end

    if recording then recTime += dt end

    uiTimer += dt
    if uiTimer >= 0.1 then
        uiTimer = 0
        local alt = gy and (pos.Y - gy) or pos.Y
        local dist = (pos - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
        local zoomX = DEFAULT_FOV / fov
        local bat = math.floor(battery)
        local telemetry = string.format("ALT %dm  VEL %d  DIST %dm\n🔋 %d%%  🔍 x%.1f",
            math.floor(alt), math.floor(curVel.Magnitude), math.floor(dist), bat, zoomX)

        local state = flying and modeNames[mode] or (battery < 100 and "A CARREGAR" or "NO CHÃO")
        screenLabel.Text = "📡 " .. state .. "\n" .. telemetry
        hudTelemetry.Text = telemetry

        local bc = battery > 50 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
            or battery > 20 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
            or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
        ledStatus.TextColor3 = bc
        ledStatus.Text = string.format("🔋 %d%%  [ DJI RC - LINKED ]", bat)

        if recording then
            local blink = math.floor(recTime * 2) % 2 == 0
            hudRec.Text = string.format("[ %s REC %02d:%02d ]", blink and "🔴" or "⚫",
                math.floor(recTime / 60), math.floor(recTime % 60))
        else
            hudRec.Text = "[ ⏺ STANDBY ]"
        end
    end
end))

scripts.script:
--========================================================--
-- GOJO NPC KILLER
-- R6 + R15 | MOBILE + PC
--
-- Blue            = 3s cooldown
-- Red             = 5s cooldown + red explosion
-- Hollow Purple   = 10s cooldown + BIG
-- Limitless Fly   = 5s cooldown / INFINITE FLIGHT
-- Teleport        = 3s cooldown
--
-- LIMITLESS FLY:
-- • Infinite duration
-- • Control with WASD / mobile joystick
-- • Camera controls direction
-- • Unequip tool to stop flying
-- NPC ONLY
--========================================================--

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

--========================================================--
-- CHARACTER
--========================================================--

local Character
local Humanoid
local Root

local function SetupCharacter(char)

	Character = char
	Humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	Root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

end

SetupCharacter(
	Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
)

--========================================================--
-- SETTINGS
--========================================================--

local BLUE_DAMAGE = 35
local RED_DAMAGE = 50
local PURPLE_DAMAGE = 500

local NPC_PUSH = 35
local NPC_FREEZE_TIME = 2.5

local BLUE_COOLDOWN = 3
local RED_COOLDOWN = 5
local PURPLE_COOLDOWN = 10
local FLY_COOLDOWN = 5
local TELEPORT_COOLDOWN = 3

local FLY_SPEED = 75

local TELEPORT_DISTANCE = 35

local BLUE_SPEED = 50
local RED_SPEED = 135
local PURPLE_SPEED = 180

local BLUE_SIZE = 1.5
local RED_SIZE = 1.8
local PURPLE_SIZE = 5

--========================================================--
-- SOUNDS
--========================================================--

local SOUND = {
	BlueCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	BlueFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	RedCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	RedFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	PurpleCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	PurpleFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	Impact = "rbxassetid://12222152",

	Teleport = "rbxassetid://5568266006",

	FlyStart = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	FlyEnd = "rbxassetid://12222152",
}

--========================================================--
-- COOLDOWNS
--========================================================--

local Cooldown = {
	Blue = false,
	Red = false,
	Purple = false,
	Fly = false,
	Teleport = false
}

local function TryCooldown(name, time)

	if Cooldown[name] then
		return false
	end

	Cooldown[name] = true

	task.delay(time, function()
		Cooldown[name] = false
	end)

	return true
end

--========================================================--
-- SOUND
--========================================================--

local function PlaySound(id, volume, speed)

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")

	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = volume or 1
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = speed or 1

	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = 5

	sound.Parent = Root

	sound:Play()

	Debris:AddItem(sound, 10)

end

--========================================================--
-- NPC CHECK
--========================================================--

local function GetNPC(part)

	if not part then
		return nil
	end

	local model =
		part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

	if not model then
		return nil
	end

	if model == Character then
		return nil
	end

	-- NEVER target players
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
		return nil
	end

	local humanoid =
		model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not humanoid then
		return nil
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	return model
end

--========================================================--
-- RED EXPLOSION
--========================================================--

local function RedExplosion(position)

	local part = Instance.new("Part")

	part.Name = "RedExplosion"
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		255,
		20,
		20
	)

	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	part.Transparency = 0.1

	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false

	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		255,
		0,
		0
	)

	light.Brightness = 15
	light.Range = 30
	light.Parent = part

	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		part,
		TweenInfo.new(
			0.4,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		),
		{
			Size = Vector3.new(14, 14, 14),
			Transparency = 1
		}
	)

	tween:Play()

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.Impact,
		1.5,
		0.8
	)

	Debris:AddItem(
		part,
		0.5
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- PURPLE EXPLOSION
--========================================================--

local function PurpleExplosion(position)

	local part = Instance.new("Part")

	part.Name = "HollowPurpleExplosion"

	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		180,
		0,
		255
	)

	part.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
	part.Transparency = 0.1

	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false

	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		190,
		50,
		255
	)

	light.Brightness = 30
	light.Range = 50
	light.Parent = part

	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		part,
		TweenInfo.new(
			0.7,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential,
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		),
		{
			Size = Vector3.new(30, 30, 30),
			Transparency = 1
		}
	)

	tween:Play()

	Debris:AddItem(
		part,
		0.8
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- NPC HIT
--========================================================--

local function DamageNPC(
	npc,
	damage,
	direction,
	ability
)

	local humanoid =
		npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	local npcRoot =
		npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not humanoid then
		return
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- NEVER damage players
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(npc) then
		return
	end

	-- DAMAGE
	humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)

	-- RED EFFECT
	if ability == "Red" and npcRoot then
		RedExplosion(npcRoot.Position)
	end

	-- PURPLE EFFECT
	if ability == "Purple" and npcRoot then
		PurpleExplosion(npcRoot.Position)
	end

	-- PUSH
	if npcRoot and direction then

		local push =
			Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

		push.MaxForce =
			Vector3.new(
				100000,
				100000,
				100000
			)

		push.Velocity =
			direction.Unit *
			NPC_PUSH
			+
			Vector3.new(
				0,
				8,
				0
			)

		push.Parent = npcRoot

		Debris:AddItem(
			push,
			0.15
		)

	end

	-- FREEZE
	local oldWalk =
		humanoid.WalkSpeed

	local oldJump =
		humanoid.JumpPower

	local oldRotate =
		humanoid.AutoRotate

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
	humanoid.JumpPower = 0
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	task.delay(
		NPC_FREEZE_TIME,
		function()

			if humanoid
				and humanoid.Parent
				and humanoid.Health > 0
			then

				humanoid.WalkSpeed =
					oldWalk

				humanoid.JumpPower =
					oldJump

				humanoid.AutoRotate =
					oldRotate

			end

		end
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- CREATE PROJECTILE
--========================================================--

local function CreateOrb(
	color,
	size
)

	local orb =
		Instance.new("Part")

	orb.Name = "GojoProjectile"

	orb.Shape =
		Enum.PartType.Ball

	orb.Material =
		Enum.Material.Neon

	orb.Color =
		color

	orb.Size =
		Vector3.new(
			size,
			size,
			size
		)

	orb.CanCollide = false
	orb.CanTouch = true
	orb.CanQuery = false

	orb.CastShadow = false

	orb.Parent = workspace

	local light =
		Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color =
		color

	light.Brightness =
		size * 7

	light.Range =
		size * 8

	light.Parent =
		orb

	return orb
end

--========================================================--
-- SHOOT
--========================================================--

local function Shoot(
	color,
	size,
	speed,
	lifetime,
	damage,
	fireSound,
	ability
)

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	local camera =
		workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local direction =
		camera.CFrame.LookVector

	local orb =
		CreateOrb(
			color,
			size
		)

	orb.CFrame =
		CFrame.new(
			Root.Position
			+
			direction * 4
			+
			Vector3.new(
				0,
				1,
				0
			)
		)

	local velocity =
		Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	velocity.MaxForce =
		Vector3.new(
			math.huge,
			math.huge,
			math.huge
		)

	velocity.Velocity =
		direction * speed

	velocity.Parent =
		orb

	PlaySound(
		fireSound,
		1.5,
		1
	)

	local hit = false
	local connection

	connection =
		orb.Touched:Connect(
			function(part)

				if hit then
					return
				end

				local npc =
					GetNPC(part)

				if npc then

					hit = true

					DamageNPC(
						npc,
						damage,
						direction,
						ability
					)

					if connection then
						connection:Disconnect()
					end

					orb:Destroy()

				end

			end
		)

	Debris:AddItem(
		orb,
		lifetime
	)

	task.delay(
		lifetime,
		function()

			if connection then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end

		end
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- BLUE
--========================================================--

local function UseBlue()

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Blue",
		BLUE_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.BlueCharge,
		1.2,
		1.15
	)

	task.wait(0.15)

	Shoot(
		Color3.fromRGB(
			0,
			170,
			255
		),

		BLUE_SIZE,

		BLUE_SPEED,

		3,

		BLUE_DAMAGE,

		SOUND.BlueFire,

		"Blue"
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- RED
--========================================================--

local function UseRed()

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Red",
		RED_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.RedCharge,
		1.3,
		0.85
	)

	task.wait(0.15)

	Shoot(
		Color3.fromRGB(
			255,
			40,
			40
		),

		RED_SIZE,

		RED_SPEED,

		3,

		RED_DAMAGE,

		SOUND.RedFire,

		"Red"
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- HOLLOW PURPLE
--========================================================--

local function UsePurple()

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Purple",
		PURPLE_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.PurpleCharge,
		1.5,
		0.7
	)

	local charge =
		Instance.new("Part")

	charge.Shape =
		Enum.PartType.Ball

	charge.Material =
		Enum.Material.Neon

	charge.Color =
		Color3.fromRGB(
			170,
			0,
			255
		)

	charge.Size =
		Vector3.new(
			2,
			2,
			2
		)

	charge.Anchored = true
	charge.CanCollide = false
	charge.CanTouch = false

	charge.CFrame =
		Root.CFrame *
		CFrame.new(
			0,
			1,
			-5
		)

	charge.Parent =
		workspace

	local light =
		Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color =
		Color3.fromRGB(
			190,
			50,
			255
		)

	light.Brightness = 25
	light.Range = 45

	light.Parent =
		charge

	local tween =
		TweenService:Create(
			charge,
			TweenInfo.new(
				0.7,
				Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
				Enum.EasingDirection.Out
			),
			{
				Size =
					Vector3.new(
						PURPLE_SIZE,
						PURPLE_SIZE,
						PURPLE_SIZE
					)
			}
		)

	tween:Play()

	task.wait(0.7)

	if charge then
		charge:Destroy()
	end

	Shoot(
		Color3.fromRGB(
			170,
			0,
			255
		),

		PURPLE_SIZE,

		PURPLE_SPEED,

		4,

		PURPLE_DAMAGE,

		SOUND.PurpleFire,

		"Purple"
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- LIMITLESS FLY
--========================================================--

local Flying = false
local FlyConnection
local FlyVelocity
local FlyTool

local function StopFly()

	if not Flying then
		return
	end

	Flying = false

	if FlyConnection then
		FlyConnection:Disconnect()
		FlyConnection = nil
	end

	if FlyVelocity then
		FlyVelocity:Destroy()
		FlyVelocity = nil
	end

	if Humanoid then
		Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.FlyEnd,
		1.2,
		1.2
	)

end

local function StartFly()

	if Flying then
		return
	end

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Fly",
		FLY_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	if not Root or not Humanoid then
		return
	end

	Flying = true

	Humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.FlyStart,
		1.5,
		0.8
	)

	FlyVelocity =
		Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	FlyVelocity.MaxForce =
		Vector3.new(
			math.huge,
			math.huge,
			math.huge
		)

	FlyVelocity.Velocity =
		Vector3.zero

	FlyVelocity.Parent =
		Root

	FlyConnection =
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(
			function()

				if not Flying then
					return
				end

				if not Root
					or not Root.Parent
					or not Humanoid
					or Humanoid.Health <= 0
				then

					StopFly()
					return

				end

				local camera =
					workspace.CurrentCamera

				if not camera then
					return
				end

				-- Get normal player movement
				local moveDirection =
					Humanoid.MoveDirection

				-- Camera direction
				local cameraLook =
					camera.CFrame.LookVector

				local cameraRight =
					camera.CFrame.RightVector

				-- Convert normal movement into
				-- camera-relative 3D flight movement.
				local forwardAmount =
					moveDirection:Dot(
						Vector3.new(
							cameraLook.X,
							0,
							cameraLook.Z
						).Unit
					)

				local rightAmount =
					moveDirection:Dot(
						Vector3.new(
							cameraRight.X,
							0,
							cameraRight.Z
						).Unit
					)

				local direction =
					Vector3.zero

				-- Forward/backward follows camera
				direction +=
					cameraLook *
					forwardAmount

				-- Left/right follows camera
				direction +=
					cameraRight *
					rightAmount

				-- Preserve vertical camera direction
				-- when moving forward/backward.
				if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then

					direction =
						direction.Unit

					FlyVelocity.Velocity =
						direction *
						FLY_SPEED

					-- Face the direction of flight
					Root.CFrame =
						CFrame.lookAt(
							Root.Position,
							Root.Position +
							direction
						)

				else

					-- No movement = hover in place
					FlyVelocity.Velocity =
						Vector3.zero

				end

			end
		)

end

--========================================================--
-- TELEPORT
--========================================================--

local function UseTeleport()

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Teleport",
		TELEPORT_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.Teleport,
		1.5,
		1
	)

	local camera =
		workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local direction =
		camera.CFrame.LookVector

	local params =
		RaycastParams.new()

	params.FilterType =
		Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		Character
	}

	local result =
		workspace:Raycast(
			Root.Position,
			direction *
			TELEPORT_DISTANCE,
			params
		)

	local destination

	if result then

		destination =
			result.Position -
			direction * 3

	else

		destination =
			Root.Position +
			direction *
			TELEPORT_DISTANCE

	end

	Root.CFrame =
		CFrame.new(
			destination,
			destination + direction
		)

end

--========================================================--
-- TOOL CREATION
--========================================================--

local ToolData = {
	{
		Name = "Blue",
		Tooltip = "Gojo Blue | Cooldown 3s",
		Action = UseBlue
	},

	{
		Name = "Red",
		Tooltip = "Gojo Red | Cooldown 3s",
		Action = UseRed
	},

	{
		Name = "Hollow Purple",
		Tooltip = "Hollow Purple | Cooldown 10s",
		Action = UsePurple
	},

	{
		Name = "Limitless Fly",
		Tooltip = "Infinite Flight | Unequip to stop",
		Action = StartFly
	},

	{
		Name = "Teleport",
		Tooltip = "Teleport | Cooldown 3s",
		Action = UseTeleport
	}
}

--========================================================--
-- REMOVE ONLY OUR TOOLS
--========================================================--

local function RemoveGojoTools()

	local backpack =
		Player:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Backpack"
		)

	local function Clean(container)

		if not container then
			return
		end

		for _, object in
			ipairs(container:GetChildren())
		do

			if object:IsA("Tool") then

				for _, data in
					ipairs(ToolData)
				do

					if object.Name ==
						data.Name
					then

						object:Destroy()
						break

					end

				end

			end

		end

	end

	Clean(backpack)
	Clean(Character)

end

--========================================================--
-- CREATE ONE TOOL
--========================================================--

local function CreateTool(data)

	local backpack =
		Player:WaitForChild(
			"Backpack",
			10
		)

	if not backpack then
		warn("GOJO: Backpack was not found!")
		return
	end

	-- Don't create duplicate
	if backpack:FindFirstChild(data.Name) then
		return
	end

	if Character and
		Character:FindFirstChild(data.Name)
	then
		return
	end

	local tool =
		Instance.new("Tool")

	tool.Name =
		data.Name

	tool.ToolTip =
		data.Tooltip

	tool.RequiresHandle =
		false

	tool.CanBeDropped =
		false

	tool.Enabled =
		true

	tool.Parent =
		backpack

	-- Special handling for Limitless Fly
	if data.Name == "Limitless Fly" then

		FlyTool = tool

		tool.Unequipped:Connect(
			function()

				StopFly()

			end
		)

	end

	tool.Activated:Connect(
		function()

			if not tool.Enabled then
				return
			end

			task.spawn(
				data.Action
			)

		end
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- CREATE ALL TOOLS
--========================================================--

local CreatingTools = false

local function CreateAllTools()

	if CreatingTools then
		return
	end

	CreatingTools = true

	local backpack =
		Player:WaitForChild(
			"Backpack",
			10
		)

	if not backpack then

		warn(
			"GOJO: Could not find Backpack!"
		)

		CreatingTools = false
		return

	end

	-- Small delay prevents respawn race conditions
	task.wait(0.2)

	RemoveGojoTools()

	task.wait(0.1)

	for _, data in
		ipairs(ToolData)
	do

		CreateTool(data)

	end

	CreatingTools = false

	print(
		"GOJO: All 5 tools created!"
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- RESPAWN
--========================================================--

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(
	function(newCharacter)

		StopFly()

		FlyTool = nil

		SetupCharacter(
			newCharacter
		)

		task.wait(1)

		CreateAllTools()

	end
)

--========================================================--
-- INITIAL CREATION
--========================================================--

task.spawn(
	function()

		Player:WaitForChild(
			"Backpack"
		)

		task.wait(0.5)

		CreateAllTools()

	end
)

print(
	"🌀 GOJO SCRIPT LOADED - 5 ABILITIES"
)

local count = 0
local updateplayercount = function(jobid)
 jobid = jobid:gsub("%s+","")
 count = count + 1
 local current = count

 if jobid == "" or jobid == game.JobId then
  st.Text = "PLAYERS: "..#PlayerService:GetPlayers().."/"..PlayerService.MaxPlayers
  st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 120)
  return
 end

 st.Text = "PLAYERS: Loading..."
 st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)

 task.spawn(function()
  local k, r = pcall(function()
   return game:HttpGet("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/"..game.PlaceId.."/servers/Public?limit=100")
  end)

  if count ~= current then return end

  if k and r then
   local kd, d = pcall(function() return Http:JSONDecode(r) end)
   if kd and d and d.data then
    for _, server in ipairs(d.data) do
     if server.id == jobid then
      st.Text = "PLAYERS: "..server.playing.."/"..server.maxPlayers
      st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 120)
      return
     end
    end
   end
  end

  st.Text = "PLAYERS: Unlisted/Private"
  st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 55, 55)
 end)
end
